$comment: Every tunable lives here: type, range, default, menu section. The in-VR menu and config validation both read this file.

features.camera_override.label: Stage 1: head pose owns the camera (Numpad0 toggles)

features.xr.label: Use the headset (off = desktop simulator only). Needs a restart

stereo.mode.label: 3D: alternate = one eye per frame (true 3D); mono = same picture both eyes

stereo.sync.label: 3D eye sync: hold the world still while the second eye is drawn (Shift+F4)

input.left_handed.label: Left-handed: move with the right stick (mirrors all controls)

input.stick_pitch.label: Right stick up/down also looks up/down (off: head and mouse only)

input.mod_turning.label: Mod turning (experimental): the mod turns the view; the game only follows while Faith stands still

input.body_follows_head.label: Run where you look (off: the stick and turning set the running direction)

input.turn_speed.label: Smooth turn speed at full stick

diagnostics.mod_turning_sim.label: Mod-owned turning also without a headset (developer tests)

comfort.physical_crouch.label: Crouch in real life to slide (when running) - the game has no standing crouch

comfort.crouch_depth.label: How far below standing height counts as crouching

comfort.roomscale.label: Real steps move Faith (she walks to where you stand)

hands.show.label: Show the extra gloved hands at the controllers (Faith's own hands follow you anyway)

hands.size.label: Hand size (1 = an average adult hand)

hands.collide.label: Hands stop at walls and objects (with a short buzz)

hands.touch_interact.label: Touch to interact: press a hand against a door, button or panel in front of you

hands.flick.label: Flick a hand fast into a door: heavy attack (door slam), light attack, or off

hands.flick_speed.label: How fast a flick has to be (metres per second)

combat.punch.label: Punch: a fast punch in front of you = Light attack, a hook = Heavy attack (buttons still work)

combat.punch_speed.label: How fast a punch has to be (metres per second)

combat.dodge_gesture.label: Shift by moving: a quick lean or step sideways or back = Shift that way (the trigger still works)

combat.dodge_speed.label: How quick the lean or step has to be (metres per second)

combat.rope_throw.label: MAG Rope by throwing: throw a hand up toward the point; lower the arm to let go (the grip still works)

combat.disruptor_push.label: Disruptor by an open-hand push (open the hand fully, then push); the button still works

body.arms.label: Faith's own arms follow yours (Stage 7; learns her arms from the first seconds of play)

body.arms_game_when_hanging.label: While Faith hangs (ledges, pipes, ziplines) her arms show the game's animation instead of following yours

body.forearm_twist.label: How much of your wrist's turn Faith's forearm shares (0 = all at the wrist, 1 = all in the forearm)

body.elbow_follow_hand.label: Faith's elbows follow the angle of your controllers (1; 0 = down and out, rising with the hand; 1 looked worse in PLAYTEST-7j)

body.turn_back_in_attacks.label: During your punches and kicks Faith's body keeps facing the way it did when the attack began (the game's attacks swing her round)

body.fingers.label: Faith's fingers follow yours: index from the trigger, the other three from the grip (her thumb stays with the hand)

diagnostics.bone_poke_piece.label: Recon: lift this Faith body piece 30 cm (1-based draw order, 0 off; developer)

diagnostics.bone_poke_bone.label: Recon: only this bone of the piece (-1 all; developer)

diagnostics.hand_sim.label: Simulated hands in front of you without a headset (developer tests)

diagnostics.hand_sim_closeup.label: Simulated hands close in front of the eyes, turned inwards (developer screenshots)

diagnostics.room_sim.label: Room-scale also without a headset (developer tests)

diagnostics.room_explain.label: Room-scale: count only the walking it asked for (developer A/B)

rendering.taa_per_eye.label: Anti-aliasing history kept per eye (sharper, less shimmer in 3D)

camera.pitch_source.label: Look up/down from: auto (headset if present), game (mouse/stick), head

diagnostics.typeinfo_dump.label: Recon: dump engine type list once (developer)

diagnostics.stereo_experiment.label: Stage 2 experiment: two views per frame via split-screen (developer)

diagnostics.fov_test.label: Apply the full-FOV override without a headset, with a stand-in 90 deg FOV (developer)

diagnostics.cb_capture.label: Recon: F10 captures one frame of shader constants (developer)

diagnostics.time_recon.label: Recon: record which code reads the clock, once, at the menu (developer)

diagnostics.zero_ipd.label: Both eyes drawn from the head centre - for checking that the eyes of a pair match (developer)

diagnostics.ipd_scale.label: Eye separation x this (developer checks; 1 = real)

diagnostics.ipd_vertical.label: Eyes stacked vertically instead of side by side (developer checks)

diagnostics.taa_motion_fix.label: Per-eye TAA: correct motion vectors to this eye's previous camera (developer A/B)

diagnostics.motion_fix_debug.label: Per-eye TAA: run the motion fix but write zeros (developer)

diagnostics.motion_fix_jitter.label: Per-eye TAA: jitter term in the motion fix (developer)

diagnostics.sync_hold_dt.label: Eye sync: dt reported on held frames (developer)

comfort.game_camera_motion.label: Feel the game's camera motion: rolls, wall-run tilt, landing dips (F5). Intense

comfort.height_offset.label: Extra eye height (F3 up / F2 down)

rendering.full_fov.label: Fill the headset's whole field of view (off = the game's own FOV in a window)
